messages:
Maria: Heads-up — analytics pipeline dropped a subset of spans starting ~04:00 UTC across api-gateway and core-service. Dashboards show a gap and trace/metric mismatch. Opening thread to capture owners and action items.
incident-bot: Incident recorded (span-loss-1795) — postmortem skeleton created.
Cheng: I was looking at the ETL logs. The aggregation job shows a ~40% drop in span inserts around 03:48. Might be related to the dedup/filter change deployed last night.
Priya: I can own alerting + short-term mitigation. Plan: update alert thresholds (4h), enable fallback aggregation path (24h). Will report back when alert rule pushed.
Miguel: I'll check streaming infra (Kinesis/SQS) and consumer offsets. If consumers lagged we might have transient loss.
Emma: I'll add this to the observability board and start a quick regression test for span counts vs traces. Can we get a representative query?
Cheng: Example query I used: `SELECT count(*) FROM spans WHERE ingestion_time BETWEEN '2027-03-01T03:30:00Z' AND '2027-03-01T05:00:00Z' GROUP BY service`. Also found a recent flag `drop_legacy_spans=true` in core-service v2.3 — that may have dropped unlabeled spans.
Jordan: Need ETA for customer dashboards and comms. Priya, please coordinate any external notifications.
Maria: Action item list so far: 1) Alerts + short mitigation (Priya, 24h), 2) Root-cause fix for dedup/filter (Cheng, 48h), 3) Consumer autoscaling + backlog check (Miguel, 48h), 4) Regression tests + daily detection job (Emma, 72h). Add owners to postmortem doc.
Priya: I'll push alert update in the next 3h. Alert will notify #oncall and create a PagerDuty if ratio of spans/traces drops >10% for 15m.
Miguel: Found consumer lag on kinesis-shard-7, consumer restarted at 05:10 and caught up. I'll add an autoscaler for consumers and a consumer-lag dashboard. ETA for autoscaler 48h.
Cheng: Opening PR to revert/adjust the dedup filter in core-service and add unit tests for service-tagless spans. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/1795-revert-dedup — ETA 36-48h for review and canary.
Emma: For recurring pattern detection I propose `obs.daily_span_trace_delta` job that computes daily ratio of spans to traces and alerts on >10% deviation vs 7d median. Will prototype in 3 days and add to CI nightlies.
Jordan: Also let's capture customers potentially impacted (listing dashboards and internal scorecards). Maria can you add the list to the PM section of the postmortem?
Maria: Done — added a stub here: https://redwood.company/postmortems/1795-span-drop. Please append owner lines and timelines.
Priya: Quick comms plan: internal note to analytics & support teams once alerts are live; external comms only if dashboards remain degraded >48h.
Cheng: Root cause draft: unintended behavior from dedup flag + ETL windowing edge-case during high traffic window. Will finalize in postmortem with repro steps.
Emma: I've prototyped the nightly diff job and pushed a config PR to obs infra. Link: https://git.redwood/obs/1795-nightly-diff. Needs one more review then I'll enable schedule.
Miguel: After the restart the backlog showed ~120k spans delayed — no data lost, but downstream aggregation window dropped them because they arrived outside expected time window. Adding slack to windowing logic as part of fix.
Maria: Everyone — please update the postmortem doc with owner, ETA, and acceptance criteria by EOD. We'll have a remediation sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Priya: :thumbsup: Alerts deployed to staging; will push to prod after a quick smoke in 1h.
incident-bot: Postmortem updated and assigned to team: observability/analytics.
Cheng: PR opened and linked in the postmortem. I'll post status when canary is complete.
Emma: Prototype for daily detection merged to main branch. Scheduling job for nightly run.
Miguel: Autoscaler config PR open. Adding runbook steps for manual scaling in case autoscaler fails.
Maria: Check-in planned for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Thanks all — please add any blockers in-thread.
